Name: Charming Shane - A cleaner look for Shane
Author: PakaDreams
Description:
[b][font=Arial][size=4][color=#f9cb9c]PakaDreams' Charming Shane - A cleaner look for Shane[/color]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][/font][/b][font=Arial][size=3]Do you feel sad for Shane too? With his teared down blue Joja Mart clothes?

This has an end now! Because now you can let him wear some nice clothes in all seasons and on Ginger Island.
This mod changes Shane's sprites and portraits. Please have a look at the pictures.

EXTRA: No more stubble beard 🧔🏻
[/size]
[size=4][color=#f9cb9c]
[b]Requirements
[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]latest Version of SMAPI
[*]latest version of Content Patcher
[/list]
[color=#dd7e6b][b][color=#b6d7a8]
Installation
[/color][/b][/color]
[/size][list=1]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url] (or use the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400] Nexus site[/url]) [/size][/font]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url][font=Arial] and unzip it into[/font] [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/mods[/font][/size]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Download this mod and unzip it into[/font] [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/mods.[/font][/size]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Have fun.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Arial]
[size=4][b][color=#ea9999]
Deinstallation
[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Delete the mod from your mod folder[/size][/font]
[/list][/font]
[b][size=4][font=Arial][color=#ffe599]
Compatibility[/color][/font][/size]
[/b][/font][font=Arial][size=3]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Works only with Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Won't work with other mods which change the sprites and portraits of Shane![/size][/font]
[font=Arial][size=3](Besides mods where you can toggle the sprites/portraits off manually, e. g. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url])[/size][/font][*][font=Arial][size=3]You can use it in co-op[/size][/font]
[/list]
